title: ESB Networks Ltd, Basis of Charges for Connection to the Distribution System, revision 1, effective 8 February 2010: the standard domestic connection capacities and the definition of Maximum Import Capacity
used_for: D27's max_import_kw. The document states that 'Domestic connections are only available for the standard capacities of 3kVA, 12kVA, 16kVA, 20kVA and 29kVA' and treats 12kVA as the standard domestic connection, so the connection capacity on the card is a published figure rather than a round guess. It is published in kVA and the schema declares the field in kW; the conversion at unity power factor is stated on the dataset rather than left implicit. Exposure `none`.
